articles.title_en: Welfare and Distribution in State-Led Wildlife Management
Extended Producer Responsibility and Trade Flows in Waste: The Case of Batteries
articles.title_cn: 延伸生产者责任与废弃物贸易流动：以电池为例
articles.abstract_en: In the debate on international waste trade, the focus on resource efficiency and recycling has gradually begun to accompany the focus on negative environmental externalities. In this context, we examine the impact of extended producer responsibility (EPR) on the export of waste batteries (WB). EPR is considered as a key policy for the “marketization of waste”. WB are a hazardous waste that also contain a high concentration of critical raw materials. As such, they are of strategic importance for the recovery of critical resources, while at the same time requiring proper environmental management. Therefore, it is crucial to understand where WB are treated and how this is affected by related policies. Our results, based on difference-in-difference models in a gravity framework, show a consistent increase in WB exports after EPR implementation compared to the trend for other wastes. This result is likely to be an indirect consequence of the ability of EPR to support growth in waste collection rates, more accurate tracking of transboundary waste flows, and specialization of national waste management systems. In particular, WB exports appear to be directed to countries with more advanced waste management systems, more stringent environmental regulations, and limited endowments of the mineral resources typically contained in batteries.
articles.abstract_cn: 在国际废弃物贸易的讨论中，对资源效率和回收利用的关注已逐渐开始伴随对负面环境外部性的关注。在此背景下，我们考察了延伸生产者责任（EPR）对废电池（WB）出口的影响。EPR被视为废弃物“市场化”的关键政策。废电池是一种危险废弃物，同时也含有高浓度的关键原材料。因此，它们对于关键资源的回收具有战略重要性，同时需要适当的环境管理。因此，了解废电池在何处处理以及相关政策如何影响这一点至关重要。我们的结果基于引力框架中的双重差分模型，显示与其它废弃物的趋势相比，EPR实施后废电池出口持续增加。这一结果可能是EPR支持废弃物收集率增长、越境废弃物流动更准确追踪以及国家废弃物管理系统专业化的间接后果。特别是，废电池出口似乎流向废弃物管理系统更先进、环境法规更严格以及通常含于电池中的矿产资源禀赋有限的国家。

articles.title_en: Simple Stated Preference Questions Can Enhance Transdisciplinary Projects: Linking Perceived Risks With Willingness to Spray and Pay
articles.title_cn: 简单的陈述性偏好问题可以增强跨学科项目：将感知风险与喷洒和支付意愿联系起来
articles.abstract_en: Transdisciplinary projects can uncover crucial insights on people’s past and future risk-mitigation behavior. We focus on a novel risk context: increasing health threats from ticks on Staten Island, a New York City borough where the combination of high population density and extensive park systems and green spaces has resulted in a rise in locally-acquired tick-transmitted disease cases. We administered a knowledge, attitudes, and practices survey that additionally included simple economic stated preference questions about people’s willingness to spray tick pesticides in the future. We first analyze factors that are correlated with people’s perceptions of two types of risks: exposure to ticks and infection with Lyme disease. Next, we use the nonmarket valuation questions to test people’s willingness to spray and pay as a function of attributes of the hypothetical pesticides, including cost, effectiveness, and type. Across all model specifications, overall willingness to pay (WTP) to spray increases with increases in pesticide effectiveness, as well as with favorable pesticide type (organic). We uncover threshold pesticide effectiveness levels at which WTP to spray turns positive, and we find that lower pesticide effectiveness is required for organic pesticide. Finally, we test how perceived risks and various individual-specific characteristics correlate with WTP to spray. Combinations of higher perceived risks are linked both with higher WTP and lower breakeven pesticide effectiveness. Our work shows that a broad range of variables influence demand for self-protection actions, both directly and indirectly (through their effects on perceived risks). Such insights on people’s tradeoffs carry important policy implications, but they can be missed if economic information is either not elicited or elicited alone.
articles.abstract_cn: 跨学科项目可以揭示关于人们过去和未来风险缓解行为的关键见解。我们关注一个新颖的风险背景：纽约市斯塔滕岛蜱虫带来的健康威胁日益增加，该行政区人口密度高，公园系统和绿地广泛，导致本地获得性蜱传疾病病例增加。我们进行了一项知识、态度和实践调查，其中还包括关于人们未来喷洒蜱虫杀虫剂意愿的简单经济陈述性偏好问题。我们首先分析与人们对两种风险感知相关的因素：接触蜱虫和感染莱姆病。接下来，我们使用非市场估值问题来测试人们喷洒和支付的意愿，作为假设杀虫剂属性（包括成本、有效性和类型）的函数。在所有模型规格中，总体支付意愿（WTP）随杀虫剂有效性的提高以及有利的杀虫剂类型（有机）而增加。我们发现了WTP转为正值时的阈值杀虫剂有效性水平，并发现有机杀虫剂所需的有效性较低。最后，我们测试了感知风险和各种个体特定特征如何与喷洒WTP相关。较高感知风险的组合与较高的WTP和较低的盈亏平衡杀虫剂有效性相关。我们的工作表明，广泛的变量直接影响或间接（通过其对感知风险的影响）影响自我保护行动的需求。这些关于人们权衡的见解具有重要的政策含义，但如果经济信息未被引出或单独引出，这些见解可能会被遗漏。

articles.title_en: Domestic Pollution Havens: Linking Interregional Capital Flight and Water Pollution Regulation in China
The Distributional Effects of Temperature Changes: Evidence from China’s Cement Industry
Effectiveness and Heterogeneous Effects of Purchase Grants for Electric Vehicles
articles.title_cn: 电动汽车购买补贴的有效性和异质效应
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate German purchase subsidies for battery electric vehicles (BEVs) and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEVs) using data on new vehicle registrations in Germany during 2015-2022. We account for confounding time trends and interacting EU-level $$\text {CO}_{2}$$ standards using neighboring countries as a control group. We find that 40% of BEV and 25% of PHEV registrations were subsidy-induced. The program had strong distributional effects, with greater uptake in wealthier and greener counties. We estimate implied abatement costs of 870 euro per ton of $$\text {CO}_{2}$$ for BEVs and 2,470 euro for PHEVs, suggesting that policy makers should re-balance support schemes away from PHEVs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用2015-2022期间德国新车注册数据评估德国对纯电动汽车（BEV）和插电式混合动力电动汽车（PHEV）的购买补贴。我们使用邻国作为对照组，考虑了混杂的时间趋势和相互作用的欧盟级别 $$\text {CO}_{2}$$ 标准。我们发现 40% 的 BEV 和 25% 的 PHEV 注册是由补贴引起的。该计划具有很强的分配效应，在较富裕和较环保的县中得到了更多的采用。我们估计纯电动汽车每吨 $$\text {CO}_{2}$$ 的隐含减排成本为 870 欧元，插电式混合动力汽车的隐含减排成本为 2,470 欧元，这表明政策制定者应重新平衡对插电式混合动力汽车的支持计划。
